facts.fact: 火后周日：Brunswick Street Mario's 午餐（恶心吃不下）、随手翻 Infinite Jest、Grub Street 书店、死亡数字继续涨、沙发上断续打盹——梦见飞机降落巴黎 CDG：停机坪上孤单的喷气机、画面黑白「仿佛全世界的颜色都被抽干」；下一幕飞机起火、一堵黑烟高墙吞掉视线。
facts.anchor: dreamt I was in a plane flying into CDG Airport in Paris

facts.fact: 夜行 Fitzroy→city（几乎记不得路）——情绪状态三级递增：despair-elation→＋mystification→＋stupefaction；不断提醒自己「还活着，尽管失去了一切」；「It's a strange feeling not having any possessions」。

Pellegrini's 前 25 年老三样（lasagne＋黄油面包＋冰 granita）；Job Warehouse 窗前想给 Bambi 买棉麻（她是好裁缝、自己做 hippy 裙）——随即意识到 unlikely 但仍盼复合；「Saturday 的 hellscape 与 Sunday 的 civility 反差惊人」、觉得快死了却进不去店门——盯着那个角落：20、25、30、35、40 岁都站在同一位置；店在眼前旋转、膝盖如果冻跪倒、头磕人行道；救护车→St Vincent's Emergency——Cherie：目睹他倒下、叫救护车、又步行到医院确认的 guardian angel（「I am unused to such human kindness」）；医生清创（脸部与手臂 lacerations）、右踝韧带撕裂（前一天伤的）；半夜打车回妹妹家被骂；用 Cherie 的电话打给 Bambi 母亲——「Tell Bambi I'm in Emergency...I'm dying」→deadpan 回答「There's no need to do that – grow up! Bambi will speak to you in three months but not before, goodbye」。
facts.anchor: The woman, Cherie, was a guardian angel who had seen me collapse

facts.fact: 周一：老板准整周假；警方名单上他与伴侣都在「missing presumed dead」；后来才知道房子四周发现骨头——是 wallaby 骨；St Andrews 火灾死亡 14 人（未经证实）引发一阵发抖与将晕感；被问是否正常吃饭喝水——「忘记吃，跟发生的事比不重要」；「I had been cut free – like the cutting of an umbilical cord – from all sorts of familiar things and worldly goods...free-floating in space thousands of miles above the Earth」——老板没接话；「missing presumed dead」变成 metaphor（felt dead for a few months）；「walked through the looking glass to the other side, to the living side, when Death, triumphant and jeering, had called to visit」；第二人生之问；「escaped our Judgement Day via a sleight of hand and stealth」；妹妹的善意无法共情（没有共同语言——felt dead to the world）。
facts.anchor: my name and the name of my partner were listed under missing presumed dead

facts.fact: 周一阅读疗伤：Infinite Jest 零翻＋妹妹书架上的《A Supposedly Fun Thing I'll Never Do Again》——「在火中躲进坝里混凝土管是一件 supposedly fun thing I will never do again」（下次早点撤离火区）；官方政策『Stay or Go』应改成『Go or Maybe Die』；周二犯傻去报社——全员劝回、谎称 fine、老板威胁叫保安押送；妥协：只留两小时写次日版的第一人称生还记；越写越怒——St Andrews 当天没有任何 radio warnings，这一通信失职置许多人于险地。
facts.anchor: should be amended to ‘Go or Maybe Die’

facts.fact: 写下『Stay or Go』四个词的瞬间他拔掉显示器所有线、连机带屏掷出窗外；先前密封的大楼涌入空气——「there had been a release, I had made a decision, I had acted」——得意退潮后拿起皮衣离开；墨尔本街头漫走：Flinders Street 车站的大钟、Princes Bridge、National Gallery 后花园的草坪——仰望云在无尽蓝天上从容移动，想起《War and Peace》里躺卧在 Pratzen Heights 战场上的 Prince Andrei；下一段故事预告（报社强制的年轻金发女心理医生）改日再讲；「What an incredible ordeal...pleased it's over」→「It's not over …」；他只要安静与睡眠；回到 lounge——「the party people all seemed, momentarily, to be bushfire survivors of one type or another」。
facts.anchor: unplugged all its leads and threw it through a window
